# Dactor Healthcare Platform — Full LLM Knowledge Specification
> Nepal's Realtime Healthcare OPD Queue Management, Clinic Portal & Diagnostic Laboratory Ecosystem.
> Official Website: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/ (mirror: https://dactorofficial.github.io/)

## Executive Overview
Dactor is an integrated healthcare technology system engineered specifically for the healthcare landscape of Nepal. It bridges the communication gap between healthcare providers (doctors, clinics, polyclinics, diagnostic pathology labs) and patients seeking OPD (Outpatient Department) consultations and diagnostic examinations.

Key Pain Points Solved:
1. **Waiting Room Congestion**: Traditional OPD queues in Nepal require patients to wait physically for hours without knowing when their turn is. Dactor provides real-time token tracking with live wait-time calculations and dynamic delay notifications.
2. **Instant Doctor Booking**: Direct digital appointment booking without requiring registration barriers; immediate 10-digit tracking code generation.
3. **Diagnostic Lab Integration**: Direct ordering and delivery of certified lab reports (MRI, CT Scan, Ultrasound, Blood Tests).

## Diagnostic Pathology & Imaging Services
Patients can schedule lab visits for diagnostic imaging and pathological investigations:
- **Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI Scan)**: Brain MRI, Spine MRI, Musculoskeletal & Joint MRI
- **Computed Tomography (CT Scan)**: Head CT, Chest CT, Abdomen & Pelvis CT
- **Ultrasonography (USG)**: Abdomen & Pelvis Ultrasound, Obstetric / Antenatal Ultrasound, Thyroid USG
- **Digital X-Ray**: Chest X-Ray, Bone & Spine Radiography
- **Pathology & Biochemistry**: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Liver Function Tests (LFT), Renal Function Tests (KFT), Lipid Profile, Fasting / PP Blood Sugar, HbA1c, Thyroid Panel (T3, T4, TSH), Urine Routine & Microscopic Examination
- **Direct Lab Booking Filter URL**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?tab=clinics&filter=lab
- **Lab Reports Portal URL**: https://dactorofficial.github.io/dactor/?tab=lab-reports
